verdict.rationale: Carta documents a public API platform with a self-serve developer portal and playground [carta-docs-3, carta-docs-4], OAuth 2.0 including a client-credentials flow suited to unattended agents [carta-docs-6, carta-docs-7], a promotion path to production [carta-docs-5], and per-endpoint reference docs. Those endpoints cover reads such as cap tables, stakeholders, option grants and FMVs, plus some writes such as draft option grants and draft issuers [carta-docs-18, carta-docs-19, carta-docs-20, carta-docs-22, carta-docs-23, carta-docs-33]. However, the reference endpoints are versioned v1alpha1, the write surface shown is limited to drafts, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt [carta-probe-3, carta-probe-1]; missing for 10: broad write/control coverage beyond drafts, a stable non-alpha API version, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
